scope: General source-witness library v1 for web-session/source-audit reuse, full twelve-part set
publication_decision: Source-intake / project-source upload candidate only. This is not a cumulative TeX/PDF reader update, not a paper patch, not certification, and not a critical edition.
contents_summary: Parts 01-08: collected-volume/tail witnesses, Internet Archive Mathematische Annalen host-volume sources, current targeted witnesses, P29/P30, P09-P20 non-overlap witnesses, P31-P43 upper-band witnesses, and P01-P08/P21-P23 bridge source material.
Part 09: official GDZ raw source upgrade for Papers 14, 15, and 16.

Part 10: Paper 10 Internet Archive Mathematische Annalen 77 issue 4 secondary JP2/PDF/source-disposition witness; useful secondary evidence but no TeX patch and not a replacement for better GDZ pages.
Part 11: Papers 19 and 20 GDZ paper-level source masters with article cutouts, raw full-page images, IIIF/GDZ manifests, page/canvas maps, dimensions, and source-quality ledgers.

Part 12: Papers 17 and 18 official GDZ source masters. P17 covers Math. Z. 8 printed pp.1-35 for 'Moduln in nichtkommutativen Bereichen'; P18 covers the one-page JDMV 30 p.101 Hentzelt discussion note. Includes raw full-page images, article cutouts, IIIF/GDZ manifests, page/canvas maps, image-dimension ledgers, and current R127 survival/no-fix ledgers.
quality_label: source-witness library / source-intake support; not cumulative reader, not TeX promotion, not certification
public_caveat: This source library is intended as stable source material for audit and web-session continuation. It contains witnesses, metadata, source ledgers, crops, source PDFs/JP2 archives, and GDZ/IA raw source upgrades; it does not by itself certify the Noether edition, synchronize translations, or promote any new TeX patch. Several witnesses remain best-available below the preferred uniform 650+ ppi optical floor; use per-paper ledgers before claiming symbol-level certification.
next_action: If uploaded, upload the manifest ZIP plus all twelve source-library parts as project source files or as a clearly labelled source-support supplement. Keep active working TeX/audit changes in separate compact rollups.
